capabilities: Render a progress bar from checkbox completion
Refresh progress bars at a configurable interval
Compute progress for nested checklists as averages of sub-tasks
Track multiple checklist sections per note with separate blocks
Color the bar by completion status
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's task lists show checkbox states but give no automatic visual summary of how much of a checklist is complete.
summary: Progress-bar plugin that renders an auto-updating progress bar for checkbox completion inside flowtick code blocks.
